status: proposed instrument; scores are the author's rubric applied to cited evidence, not a standard or legal finding

rubric.data_residency_egress: 1 = prompts and outputs never leave the organisation's device; 0.75 = processed by default in the EU with documented possible transfers; 0.5 = EU with routine transfers; 0 = outside the EU or unknown
rubric.operator_jurisdiction: 1 = the organisation operates the inference itself; 0.75 = EU-headquartered operator under EU law; 0.25 = non-EU operator; 0 = unknown
rubric.model_openness: 1 = open weights, licence file opened at a pinned revision, self-hostable; 0.75 = open weights, licence declared on the model card only; 0.25 = API access only; 0 = unknown
rubric.operational_independence: 1 = runs offline from checksum-pinned files we hold; 0.75 = offline but from a third-party conversion we did not verify; 0.25 = depends on a network service and the vendor's model versioning
rubric.transparency_auditability: 1 = weights, training data and logs inspectable; 0.5 = weights plus a technical report, training data not released; 0.25 = technical report only; 0 = undisclosed
rubric.supply_chain: 1 = every layer from EU or self-controlled sources; 0.5 = mixed origin layers (model publisher, runtime, hardware), each identified; 0.25 = provider-controlled stack with listed subprocessors; 0 = unidentified

evidence.data_residency_egress: Inference runs in a local llama.cpp process with no network client (scripts/bench_run.py); the Mac benchmark made no network calls during inference.
evidence.operator_jurisdiction: Self-operated by the deploying organisation in this design.
evidence.model_openness: Owner GGUFs at pinned revisions; Apache-2.0 declared on the cards; licence file opened only for the 1.5B revision (docs/protocols/2026-10-14-shortlist.md).
evidence.transparency_auditability: Qwen2.5 technical report (arXiv:2412.15115); training data not released.
evidence.supply_chain: Model publisher Alibaba Qwen (CN), runtime llama.cpp (open source), hardware Apple (US).

evidence.operator_jurisdiction: Self-operated by the deploying organisation in this design.
evidence.model_openness: Apache-2.0 declared on the pinned upstream card (c170c708...); no standalone licence file in the listed tree.
evidence.operational_independence: Runs offline, but from a third-party GGUF conversion (bartowski) whose source revision we did not verify.
evidence.transparency_auditability: Mistral 7B paper (arXiv:2310.06825); training data not released.
evidence.supply_chain: Model publisher Mistral AI (FR), third-party converter, runtime llama.cpp, hardware Apple (US).

evidence.data_residency_egress: Mistral Help Center, 'Where do you store my data or my Organization's data?' (page dated 12 Aug 2026, opened 17 Oct 2026): EU hosting by default; some features may transfer data outside the EU temporarily under GDPR Article 46 safeguards; a separate US endpoint exists. https://help.mistral.ai/en/articles/347629-where-do-you-store-my-data-or-my-organization-s-data
evidence.operator_jurisdiction: Mistral AI is headquartered in France.
evidence.model_openness: Scored as API access; served model versions vary and some are not open-weight.
evidence.operational_independence: Requires network access and the vendor's model lifecycle.
evidence.transparency_auditability: Provider documentation; no access to serving infrastructure or logs beyond the account.
evidence.supply_chain: Provider-controlled stack with a published subprocessor list (Trust Center).
